aggressive_definition: Aggressive incident prostate cancer; the abstract does not provide staging, grade, metastatic, or lethality criteria.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: there was a stronger inverse association for aggressive prostate cancers
study_design: Prospective nested case-control study using baseline plasma samples from healthy men followed for incident prostate cancer
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Subjects included 578 men who developed prostate cancer within 13 years of follow-up and 1294 age- and smoking status-matched controls.
reason: Healthy men provided plasma before follow-up, and the abstract separately reports associations for all incident prostate cancers and aggressive incident prostate cancers. The criteria defining aggressive disease are not stated.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: For men with low lycopene, beta-carotene supplements were associated with risk reductions comparable to those observed with high lycopene.
estimate_classifications.reason: This beta-carotene row is stated as prostate cancer risk reduction without designation as aggressive disease; it must not be relabeled based on the paper's separate aggressive analyses.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The ORs for all prostate cancers declined slightly with increasing quintile of plasma lycopene (5th quintile OR = 0.75, 95% CI = 0.54-1.06; P, trend = 0.12)
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported OR of 0.75 is explicitly for all prostate cancers, not the separately reported aggressive endpoint.

additional_estimates.comparison: fifth versus reference quintile of plasma lycopene
additional_estimates.effect_excerpt: there was a stronger inverse association for aggressive prostate cancers (5th quintile OR = 0.56, 95% CI = 0.34-0.91; P, trend = 0.05).
additional_estimates.count_excerpt: Subjects included 578 men who developed prostate cancer within 13 years of follow-up and 1294 age- and smoking status-matched controls.
additional_estimates.endpoint_definition: Aggressive incident prostate cancer; specific criteria were not provided in the abstract.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
